response_rule: Every success, denial, validation error, authentication error and unavailable response carries the declared private no-store headers.
A masked or unavailable response contains no operation payload, protected label, media access ref or action ref.
Foreign request and response fields are rejected recursively before composition or display.
A late response is displayable only when its request generation and full protected-cache partition still match the active consumer state.
Transport failure and device offline state are consumer boundary states and are never reported as owner facts.

current_owner_facts: active Participant bound from the authenticated My-Chat user
exact family and child-care-process association selected by context_ref
one current Enrollment and its exact CareGroup
current child-link Grant, visibility, purpose and protected-display policy
owner_resolution.ambiguous_enrollment_rule: Zero or multiple current Enrollment candidates fail closed as ambiguous_context; Nurture never picks the first candidate.
owner_resolution.safe_projection: Responses expose only parent presenter role/scope metadata and opaque refs; no Participant, RoleAssignment, Enrollment, Grant, CareGroup or raw identity is returned.
owner_resolution.context_ref_rule: context_ref is routing input and a cache dimension, never authorization; drift returns a mask signal before any prior payload can render.

enum_policy.wire_enums: Only presenter display, transport and safe-recovery vocabularies declared in this artifact may cross the boundary.
enum_policy.mapping_rule: The future owner adapter maps current domain and persistence facts into this vocabulary and never serializes Prisma or domain enum names directly.

safe_reason_codes.meaning: Current participant, role, association, enrollment, grant or scope authority no longer permits this presentation.
The supplied context_ref or its current owner binding no longer names the active presentation context.
Current owner facts do not resolve exactly one eligible enrollment context.
Current owner policy does not permit protected content to display.
Refresh failed with a contract, authority or policy condition that blind retry cannot repair.
The requested owner projection is not currently available without disclosing whether a protected source exists.
A transient owner read failed before a response payload was composed.
The request did not satisfy the closed schema or exact-pin admission rule.
A currently visible activity has no currently issuable protected-media access ref.
The actor-bound notice confirmation expired before commit.
The confirmation was consumed without a provable matching committed result.
The notice confirmation is malformed or is not bound to this actor and interface.
The notice, action eligibility or reviewed owner heads changed after prepare.
The confirm request may have crossed the durability boundary and only the same command may be reconciled.

rules: A cache entry belongs to exactly one full dimension tuple; no prefix, role, context or contract fallback is permitted.
Scope replacement, access_changed, context_changed or ambiguous_context synchronously purges the affected Nurture parent-context partition before navigation or replacement render.
Protected display denial removes content itself, action refs and media access refs; disabling controls alone is insufficient.
Offline may display only an unexpired, privacy-valid snapshot as read-only; owner-backed writes and media access refresh stay disabled.
Stale display requires an explicit current response permission and never authorizes a notice action or media access refresh.
Starting a refresh does not extend snapshot or media expiry, and a failed refresh never overwrites a valid entry.
Non-retryable refresh failure masks old rows; a newer request generation always defeats a late completion.
Notice outcome_unknown preserves only protected same-command correlation and cannot create a substitute command.

compatibility.additive_change: New optional fields or operations require a new additive minor and a new digest; consumers continue to use their exact prior pin.
compatibility.breaking_change: Removed, renamed, narrowed or reinterpreted fields, enum members, reason codes or semantics require a new major and parallel consumer migration.
compatibility.deprecation: A version remains available only under an explicit bilateral retirement record; mounting its fail-closed routes neither activates nor retires the interface.
compatibility.surface_policy: This standalone artifact does not advance or mutate nurture.surface-contract@1.20.0.

semantic_rules: The future date is never selectable; previous_date and next_date are null at their owner-defined bounds.
available_dates is an owner-confirmed display window, not evidence that attendance or content exists on a date.

The ready day response includes at most 20 activity summaries with opaque activity_ref, bounded title, occurred_at and media_state so Mobile can render cards and request the retained detail operation.
Every date selection triggers a new owner resolution and cannot reuse a previous context partition.
Each card independently reports provided or missing; missing never means zero, normal or absent.
Protected-display denial masks the complete card collection rather than returning empty protected labels.
meal, nap, activity, mood and health source payloads are reduced to bounded display strings and their owner enums never cross the boundary.
Activity detail closes and its partition purges on scope, context or revocation drift.
The requested activity_ref must be one of the summaries returned for the same context_ref and selected local_date.
A protected media item carries only an opaque owner-stream access_ref with a bounded expiry; no storage ref, signed URL or reusable link crosses this contract.
The consumer never reuses an expired or prior-partition access_ref and never caches media bytes under the presentation cache.
list, prepare_confirmation and confirm are closed sub-exchanges of this one owner operation.

The list action_ref and action_version identify exact confirmation copy; prepare returns the same identity and byte-equivalent preview copy, confirmation_ref and command_request_id, and confirm echoes that complete five-field identity tuple.
Prepare issues a five-minute-or-shorter actor/context/action-bound confirmation; confirm reruns owner resolution and revalidates notice version and eligibility before any effect.
A duplicate with provable matching committed evidence returns committed with execution_disposition replayed; otherwise it returns confirmation_replayed.
Offline, stale, masked and refresh-failed states never submit a confirmation; outcome_unknown permits only reconciliation of the same command.
A late response cannot update a replaced, revoked or newer request generation.
present, no_attendance, closed and unknown are presenter display states only and never become a second canonical attendance claim.
fresh and stale are owner response states; offline is produced only by the My-Chat async boundary when no response is available.
Stale responses are read-only, and refresh_not_retryable masks all prior Nurture parent-context rows.
